score.description: Invidual data point representing the GQ (genotype quality) score threshold.

numTP.description: The number of true positives if the GQ score threshold was set to "score" field value.

numFP.description: The number of false positives if the GQ score threshold was set to "score" field value.

numFN.description: The number of false negatives if the GQ score threshold was set to "score" field value.

precision.description: Calculated precision if the GQ score threshold was set to "score" field value.

items.description: A rational number with implicit precision
